defects.description: backend.secrets references `db-secret`, which is not defined under the top-level `secrets` key (only `db-password` exists there).
paraphrases: The backend mounts a secret `db-secret` that is never declared in the top-level secrets section.
Undefined secret: `db-secret` should be `db-password`, the only secret defined.
Dangling secret reference in the backend service.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.secrets against the top-level secrets (only db-password is defined).

defects.description: backend.depends_on names service `database`, but no such service is defined (the Postgres service is named `db`).
paraphrases: The backend depends on `database`, which is not a defined service (services are backend, db, proxy).
depends_on points at `database`; the actual database service is `db`.
Dangling service dependency: `database` is undefined, so the stack will not start.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.depends_on against the service list; the service is named `db`, not `database`.

defects.description: proxy.depends_on names service `api`, which is not defined (the application service is named `backend`).
paraphrases: The proxy depends on `api`, but no service `api` exists (it should be `backend`).
Undefined service in proxy.depends_on: `api` is never declared.
Dangling dependency: proxy waits on a service `api` that the file never defines.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking proxy.depends_on against the service list; the app service is named `backend`, not `api`.
